item.title: 7 Brew plans second Edmond drive-thru location with 50 new jobs
item.description: 7 Brew Coffee is expanding with a second drive-thru location in Edmond, expected to open in 2026 and create about 50 new jobs.

item.title: US air system under strain: frozen funding, ICE agents in airports, crash shutting LaGuardia
item.description: Air Canada crash at LaGuardia and ICE agents deployed at airports worsen delays amid frozen funding and TSA absenteeism across the U.S. air travel system.

item.title: Sharpe: On life and liberty
item.description: Jennifer Sharpe reflects on the meaning of liberty during a visit to Philadelphia and recent tragic deaths of university students in Chicago and Barcelona.

item.title: Letter from the Editor: Two lives of service remembered after fatal firetruck crash
item.description: Oklahoma volunteer firefighters Todd Pendleton and Bryan Jenkins died in a firetruck crash en route to a fire in Goldsby, leaving a legacy of heroism and community service.

item.title: US, TotalEnergies to shift nearly $1 billion from wind to oil and gas
item.description: The United States and TotalEnergies will redirect nearly $1 billion from offshore wind leases to oil and gas production in Texas, impacting U.S. energy strategy.

item.title: Oklahoma City area veterans selected for Oklahoma Warriors honor flight to Washington D.C.
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY — Three Oklahoma City area veterans will travel to Washington, D.C. next month as part of the Oklahoma Warriors Honor Flight program, joining 66 of their fellow Oklahomans for a day of recognition long overdue. item.title: Every ChatGPT prompt has an energy price. Oklahoma is already helping pay it.
item.description: ChatGPT consumes electricity equivalent to 74 percent of Oklahoma's residential use, highlighting the state's key role in powering AI with wind energy.

item.title: Wall Street indexes rise after Trump postpones strikes on Iran power plants
item.description: Wall Street indexes rose over 1% after President Donald Trump postponed strikes on Iranian power plants, boosting market optimism and lowering oil prices.

item.title: Data sovereignty under question as new tech opens up to government use
item.description: IBM's $11 billion purchase of Confluent introduces real-time data processing that could impact data sovereignty and voter registration in Oklahoma.

item.title: OHFA low-income housing program on the line
item.description: The Oklahoma Housing Finance Agency voted to suspend future low-income housing awards pending the outcome of House Bill 1823.
